{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-read the data to ensure fresh state
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = df.isnull().sum()

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = df.duplicated().sum()

# Check the distribution of the arm variable
arm_counts = df['arm'].value_counts()

# Check the distribution of responded
response_counts = df['responded'].value_counts()

# Print results
print(missing_values)
print(duplicates)
print(arm_counts)
print(response_counts)"}
